chips.description: List of hardware monitoring chips to configure. Each chip block defines how lm-sensors interprets sensor data for a specific device.

driver.description: Kernel driver name (e.g., 'it87', 'nct6775', 'lm90'). Optional; used for human reference only.

ignore.description: If true, ignore this chip entirely (skip parsing its sensors).

labels.description: Assign custom human-readable labels to sensors. Each sensor can be relabeled.

sensor.description: Sensor name (e.g., 'in0', 'temp1', 'fan3'). Must match chip's sensor identifiers.

label.description: New label for the sensor (e.g., 'CPU Voltage', 'Ambient Temp', 'System Fan').

compute.description: Apply linear transformation (y = a*x + b) to sensor readings.

from.description: Input range (e.g., '0 5') — minimum and maximum expected raw values.

to.description: Output range (e.g., '3.3 0') — desired scaled values corresponding to input range.

set.description: Override sensor behavior — set fixed limits or enable/disable features.

scan_all_i2c_buses.description: If true, scan all I²C buses for sensors (even non-default ones). Useful for non-standard hardware.

includes.description: List of external config file paths to include (e.g., '/etc/sensors.d/mb1.conf'). Useful for board-specific overrides.

items.description: Path to a config file to include (supports glob patterns like '*.conf').
